globalAnalysis.visualFlow: A dark central figure rises from the foreground rocks into layered fog, distant peaks, and an expansive pale sky.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Register and space should distinguish depth: rocks remain low, the figure is a centered human line, fog drifts, and the sky uses the widest rests.

cells.label: Cool sky opening
cells.interpretation: Cool cloud layers open a broad quiet distance.

cells.label: High luminous sky
cells.interpretation: The brightest open sky creates stillness above the landscape.

cells.label: Sky suspended above the wanderer
cells.interpretation: Nearly featureless light suspends the central figure below.

cells.label: Distant blue sky
cells.interpretation: A cool distant field carries the view beyond the frame.

cells.label: Mountain emerging from mist
cells.interpretation: A pale mountain rises gently through the atmospheric veil.

cells.label: Head against the distant peak
cells.interpretation: The small head interrupts the distant mountain and establishes the viewer's proxy.

cells.label: Remote stone towers
cells.interpretation: Vertical rock towers puncture the soft horizontal mist.

cells.label: Fog beyond the ridge
cells.interpretation: Bright fog carries the landscape toward an unseen distance.

cells.label: Left crags in moving fog
cells.interpretation: Jagged stone emerges and disappears inside moving vapor.

cells.label: The solitary back
cells.interpretation: The upright dark back anchors the boundless pale landscape.

cells.label: Wanderer facing the cliffs
cells.interpretation: The figure's stance directs attention into the broken terrain ahead.

cells.label: Bright sea of fog
cells.interpretation: A luminous sea of vapor flows between scattered cliffs.

cells.label: Foreground crag
cells.interpretation: Dense foreground stone rises sharply out of the white vapor.

cells.label: Boots planted on the summit
cells.interpretation: The legs create a firm human stance against the heavy rock.

cells.label: Figure rooted in stone
cells.interpretation: Human silhouette and rock merge into one dark central foundation.

cells.label: Rock ledge falling away
cells.interpretation: The dark ledge falls toward the luminous void beyond.
